method.commit_match: blob: the target's git blob is in an indexed repository and the chosen commit holds the most of the set's files; unit: a flattened target's units equal, after CRLF to LF and trailing-whitespace removal, an indexed file version's; nearest: no version equals the target unit, and the version with the fewest differing lines is recorded with those lines; closest: the target is in no repository and the commit holding the most set files is recorded; declared: the V1 module's own moduleGitCommit; none: no indexed repository holds any of the set's files. Among equivalent commits a branch or tag reaches (all of them when none does), the chosen one is the earliest carrying a tag, else the latest; a pull request's head counts only as that fallback
method.creation_blocks: eth_getCode is empty at block b-1 and non-empty at block b; the transaction is the factory log's, else Blockscout's creation transaction, else the block's only transaction whose logs are emitted by or name the address
method.epochs: V1: each module id's InstallerInstallModule logs in order, the Installer's from Genesis, and a proxy follows its module id from its creation block; each id's last epoch equals moduleIdToImplementation at the pinned block. V2: an upgradeable vault follows the factory's SetImplementation epochs from its creation block, a pinned vault keeps the implementation ProxyCreated names; getProxyConfig and implementation() agree at the pinned block
method.solc_reproduction: the verified input with outputSelection narrowed to the target's deployedBytecode, linkReferences and immutableReferences, compiled by the solc linux-amd64 build of its version; immutable ranges zeroed on both sides before comparison with eth_getCode at the pinned block. exact: equal; sans-cbor: equal once the trailing CBOR metadata is removed from both
method.source_sets: one compilation: target, compiler, settings and the git blob of every source file, from Blockscout's verified record, else Sourcify's; a subject without its own record joins the set whose compiled runtime best equals its code, else the set of whoever made it compiled with every contract selected; a pinned vault is built from the factory's meta proxy template; a V1 module no verifier holds is built from the commit its install log declares
method.subject_set: V1: the dispatcher's InstallerInstallModule and ProxyCreated logs from block 0, and the Installer its constructor set; V2: the sizing seed less the groups the 2026-09-28 scope excluded, closed over the factories' creation logs, the EVault factory's SetImplementation and SetUpgradeAdmin, each implementation's MODULE_*(), each vault's dToken, oracle, IRM and hook target with their Gov* logs, each router's ConfigSet and FallbackOracleSet, each CrossAdapter's legs and each subject's EIP-1967 slot. An address the closure adds is a subject when Euler wrote it: made by construction (dToken, module, factory instance), its declaring file is in an Euler repository at a commit a branch or tag reaches, its NatSpec names Euler as author, an Euler deployer made it, or its code reproduces from an Euler build; it is excluded, with its reason, otherwise
